name: Xuanzhu Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Xuanzhu Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company that researches, produces and commercialises small-molecule chemical drugs and large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Its main candidates are KBP-3571 for duodenal ulcers, XZP-3287, a CDK4/6 inhibitor for advanced HR+/HER2- breast cancer, and XZP-3621 for anaplastic lymphoma kinase-positive cancer.
